## Verification Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code adheres to the project code style and type safety standards (`mypy --strict src tests`).

- [ ] No real-world private data, personal logs, or credentials are included in tests/fixtures.
